name: Texas

licensing_agencies.name: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC), Child Care Regulation
licensing_agencies.scope: Licenses and inspects child care centers, before/after-school and school-age programs, licensed and registered child-care homes, and lists family homes statewide.

discovery.authoritative_registry: HHSC CCL Daycare and Residential Operations Data (data.texas.gov bc5r-88dy)
discovery.inspection_sources: HHSC CCL Inspection Investigation Assessment Data (m5q4-3y3d) and Non-Compliance Data (tqgd-mf4x), current, 2017-present
discovery.complaint_enforcement_policy: Inspections, report investigations and assessments are published with violation narratives and risk levels; adverse/corrective actions are flagged per operation.

notes: Second state. Current inspections with narratives.

sources.name: HHSC CCL Daycare and Residential Operations Data
sources.publisher: Texas Health and Human Services Commission, Child Care Regulation

coverage.program_classes: Licensed centers (child care, before/after school, school age), licensed and registered child-care homes, listed family homes
coverage.excludes: General residential operations and child-placing agencies are harvested but not indexed as childcare

known_limitations: No coordinates published; center addresses are geocoded with the Census Geocoder.
No owner/legal-entity field, so Texas programs are not grouped into operators.
Home-based programs are operated by individuals at their homes: street address and exact map location are not shown.

sources.name: HHSC CCL Inspection Investigation Assessment Data
sources.publisher: Texas Health and Human Services Commission, Child Care Regulation
known_limitations: Activities include routine inspections, investigations of reports and assessments. Investigation findings are summarized; abuse/neglect case details are not public here.

sources.name: HHSC CCL Non-Compliance Data
sources.publisher: Texas Health and Human Services Commission, Child Care Regulation
known_limitations: Standards are Texas Administrative Code Title 26 (Chapter 746 centers, 747 homes); not equivalent to other states' codes.

candidates.name: HHSC CCL Daycare and Residential Operations Data

candidates.description: This data set has information about Inspections, Investigations, Assessments done at each Day care  and/or Residential Care Operation. The Operation ID can be used to link the records to the operation details in the HHSC CCL Operations Data set
